main_text.l: Damnum quod quis sua {a}culpa sentit, sibi {b}debet non aliis imputare.
Certum est quod is committit in legē, qui {d}legis verba complectens contra legis nitítur voluntatem.

marginalia.note: l.46.§.5.in f.ff.de procu-ratorib : L.23. ff. de negotiis : l.52.in f.ff.pro socio.

page.notes: The left-margin note "a" is printed as "v.l.203. ff." with "eod." on the next line; I have kept both. "nitítur" is uncertain in its accent [?] and is not marked because the word itself is clear. No page number is printed. The printer's ornament below FINIS is not transcribed.
